name: OpenClaw
description: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant that runs on your own devices. It connects to the channels you already use (WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Google Chat, Signal, iMessage, Microsoft Teams, and more) and provides voice wake, talk mode, and a live canvas you control. The Gateway acts as the control plane for sessions, channels, tools, and events, giving you a local-first, fast, and always-on AI assistant.

notes.text: After installation, enter the container and run: openclaw onboard --install-daemon
The onboarding wizard will configure your Anthropic/OpenAI API keys and install the gateway service.
Requires Claude Pro/Max subscription or API key for full functionality.
